verdict: Paid ads paused since Sep 17; 90 leads banked, restart in motion.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 90 leads from Meta at a cost of $16.02 per lead, with all of that volume arriving before September 17 — paid activity has been at zero spend for 11 consecutive days since. Google Ads ran $354.66 in spend over the same window and recorded no conversions, which points to a tracking break rather than a lack of clicks. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile drove 38 direction requests and your website saw a modest uptick in sessions late in the period, but that alone cannot replace paid volume. Ad campaigns are being restarted this week alongside conversion tracking repairs, and the pipeline routing that left some incoming contacts unassigned is being corrected; you should see lead flow resume and become measurable again in the next reporting period.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before the pause
cost per lead on Meta — the benchmark to beat when ads resume

watch_item.issue: Paid ads have been paused since September 17, and Google Ads conversion tracking is broken, meaning spend was running without measurable results.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and conversion tracking is being repaired so that every click and lead is counted correctly from restart.
